title: You Are the Reason

cues.en: There goes my heart beating, cause you are the reason I'm losing my sleep
cues.zh: 我的心在跳動，因為你是我失眠的原因
cues.text: There goes my heart beating, cause you are the reason I'm losing my sleep

cues.en: Please come back now
cues.zh: 請現在回來
cues.text: Please come back now

cues.en: And there goes my mind the racing, and you are the reason
cues.zh: 我的腦海中充滿了賽車，而你就是原因
cues.text: And there goes my mind the racing, and you are the reason

cues.en: That I'm still breathing, I'm hopeless now
cues.zh: 我還在呼吸，我現在絕望了
cues.text: That I'm still breathing, I'm hopeless now

cues.en: I'd climb every mountain, and swim every ocean
cues.zh: 我會攀登每一座山，暢遊每片海洋
cues.text: I'd climb every mountain, and swim every ocean

cues.en: Just to be with you, and fix what I've broken
cues.zh: 只是為了和你在一起，修復我所破壞的東西
cues.text: Just to be with you, and fix what I've broken

cues.en: Or cause I need you to see
cues.zh: 或因為我需要你看到
cues.text: Or cause I need you to see

cues.en: There you are the reason
cues.zh: 這就是你的理由
cues.text: There you are the reason

cues.en: There goes my hand shaking, and you are the reason
cues.zh: 我的手開始顫抖，而你就是原因
cues.text: There goes my hand shaking, and you are the reason

cues.en: My heart keeps breathing, I need you now
cues.zh: 我的心仍在呼吸，我現在需要你
cues.text: My heart keeps breathing, I need you now

cues.en: And if I could turn back the clock, I'd make sure that I defeated the dark
cues.zh: 如果我能讓時光倒流，我會確保我打敗了黑暗
cues.text: And if I could turn back the clock, I'd make sure that I defeated the dark

cues.en: I'd spend every hour, all every day, keeping you safe
cues.zh: 我會花每一小時、每一天來確保你的安全
cues.text: I'd spend every hour, all every day, keeping you safe

cues.en: And I'd climb every mountain, and swim every ocean
cues.zh: 我會攀登每一座山，暢遊每一個海洋
cues.text: And I'd climb every mountain, and swim every ocean

cues.en: Just to be with you, and fix what I've broken
cues.zh: 只是為了和你在一起，修復我所破壞的東西
cues.text: Just to be with you, and fix what I've broken

cues.en: Or cause I need you to see
cues.zh: 或因為我需要你看到

cues.text: There you are the reason I'm losing my sleep

cues.zh: 我已經告訴你原因了
